path.description: File path, or base directory for glob/grep/ls/mkdir. Supports ~; a relative path is resolved against the session's working directory

start.description: First line to read, 1-based (read only, default 1). Use next_start from a truncated read to continue

end.description: Last line to read, inclusive (read only, default end of file)

content.description: Full file content (required for write, overwrites)

edits.description: Replacements applied in order (required for edit). All or nothing: if one fails the file is left untouched

old.description: Exact text to replace, copied verbatim from a read including indentation. Must be unique in file unless all is true

pattern.description: Glob pattern e.g. **/*.py (glob) or regex (grep). Required for glob, grep

include.description: Glob filter for which files to grep when path is a directory (default all text files)

context.description: Lines of context to return around each grep match, max 10 (default 0)

files_only.description: grep returns just the matching file paths, no lines. Use to find where something lives (default false)

no_ignore.description: Search inside .git, node_modules, build output and other skipped directories (default false)

to.description: Destination path for move. Must not already exist
